title: A NASA Space Station Fell on Australia. They Fined NASA $400 for Littering

scenes.text: In 1979, a NASA space station fell on Australia. Australia fined NASA for littering.
Skylab weighed 169,000 pounds. The heaviest thing ever to fall out of orbit.
NASA aimed it at the ocean. It broke up late, and chunks rained across Western Australia.
Sonic booms woke the Outback. Oxygen tanks hit the ground. Nobody was hurt.
So the town of Esperance sent NASA a 400 dollar ticket. For littering.
NASA never paid. Thirty years later, a radio host raised the cash from listeners and settled it.

description:
On July 11, 1979, NASA's 169,000 pound Skylab space station reentered the atmosphere, broke up later than planned, and scattered debris across Western Australia.
No one was hurt, but the Shire of Esperance fined NASA 400 dollars for littering. NASA never paid; in 2009 a US radio host collected the money from listeners and paid it on NASA's behalf. The oxygen tanks are now in the Esperance museum.
What would you do if a piece of space station landed in your garden?
first_comment: The debris trail stretched about 2,450 miles, from the Indian Ocean deep into Australia. If you found a piece of Skylab, would you keep it or hand it in?
